item.title: Naming rights boost 'Field of Dreams' stadium fund in New Orleans
item.description: The "Field of Dreams" project is set to move forward with $15 million already raised for construction. Some of that money came from the sale of the stadium's naming rights to an undisclosed brand.

item.title: Man found shot, killed in Seventh Ward: NOPD
item.description: The New Orleans Police Department is investigating a fatal shooting in the Seventh Ward on Wednesday, Jan. 28.

item.title: Man jumps from window to escape fire in Broadmoor
item.description: A man jumped from a second-floor window to escape a fire in New Orleans Wednesday, Jan. 28.

item.title: New Orleans City Council pauses proposed data center in New Orleans East
item.description: The plan to build a data center, MS Solar Grid Data, in New Orleans East was delayed by the New Orleans City Council due to concerns from both residents and council members.

item.title: New Orleans Police Department recruit taken into custody by ICE
item.description: A recruit with the New Orleans Police Department was taken into custody by Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

item.title: ID of victim in Fairgrounds double homicide remains a mystery
item.description: More than a week after a double homicide in the Fairgrounds neighborhood, the name of one of the victims has yet to be released.
